Why MeshOptimiser

Heavy CAD in. A fast page out.

MeshOptimiser takes the STEP assembly that is too heavy for a web page and makes it light enough to load. Repeated parts are kept once, broken geometry is rebuilt, and what nobody can see is dropped.

Every part has a row, and every action has an undo, so you can see what changed and take it back. It runs on your computer, and your files stay yours.

Clean-up tools

Advanced STEP clean-up tools, free in your browser.

Try it

Search is how you get around.

The app’s own search. Type a part, a library item, a command or a sum.

    ↑↓ choose↵ runEsc clear12*25.4 · 2 in · a part’s name

    • fastenersFinds every bolt, nut and washer by its shape and selects them.
    • hidden partsPicks the parts you cannot see from outside.
    • smart optimiseRuns every clean-up in one go.
    • remove holesCloses holes in flat faces. The shortcut is P.

    Quick remesh

    Press B. Slide. Let go.

    Read more

    Try it

    The commands come to you.

    The app’s own Quick wand. Point at a slice, click a command. Select a part and the ring changes to fit it.

    • PointA slice lights up. A group fans its commands out.
    • ClickRuns the command. Click a part first to work on it.
    • Hold WThe ring comes to the pointer. Let go on a slice to run it.
    • EscBack to the middle. Runs nothing.

    Claude·New

    Ask Claude. It does the clean-up.

    Describe the job. Claude does the clean-up with the same tools you click, asks before it changes anything, and every change is one undo.

    See how it works
    • Find all the bolts and hide them.
    • Get this under 5 MB for the web.
    • Show me before and after.

    The gearbox in these pictures is Gearbox Assy from Khronos’s glTF-Sample-Models, a JT CAD sample converted by Okino Computer Graphics. The bolts, nuts, washers and gears come from the app’s own library.
